name: fleetflow
description: FleetFlow — Smart Fleet Coordination & Logistics Management Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
